description: Deterministic KAT for the signed 1:1 handshake v5 with the DTLS fingerprint binding. Generated by scripts/handshake-v5-kat-dump.mjs with node:crypto + pure Ed25519. Every consumer pins this file's sha256. sigV5 is deterministic RFC 8032; a verifier that cannot reproduce signature bytes (CryptoKit) verifies the golden signature instead.

transcripts.layout: WIRE_SPEC 3.7: OFFER_v5 / ACCEPT_v5, DTLSFP = 0x01 || sha-256 digest (33 bytes) is the last field of each

kdf.layout: sessionKey = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = pqcSS || x25519SS, salt = psk | "q-audion-hybrid-pqc-v1", info = "q-audion-session-key" || SHA-256(ACCEPT_v5), 32); SAS = HKDF-SHA256(sessionKey, salt "qaudion-sas-v1", info "q-audion-sas-transcript" || SHA-256(ACCEPT_v5), 18) as six uint24 mod 256; KCMAC per KeyConfirmation (offer/accept bindings = SHA-256(OFFER_v5) / SHA-256(ACCEPT_v5))

negative.description: Same inputs as transcript vector v5-basic-no-psk, no PSK. In each case one leg sees a different DTLS fingerprint (a MITM terminating DTLS on both legs, signatures stripped): that leg derives a different ACCEPT_v5 hash, session key and SAS, so no media decrypts and the KCMAC fails.

frameKeys.description: frameKey_o2a / frameKey_a2o = HKDF-SHA256(IKM = sessionKey, salt = "qaudion-frame-salt-v5", info = "q-audion-frame-key-v5:" || callId || ":o2a" | ":a2o", L = 32). o = offerer (caller, signer of OFFER_v5), a = acceptor.
